title: Older resident: service access survey — UNAPPROVED draft
description: Smart Cities, Silent Citizens: Structured account of access to city and digital services. Illustrative questions newly written for application exploration, not the approved study instrument. Replace this information with the reviewed participant information and consent process. Participation is voluntary; all questions after consent are optional. Do not record names, contact details, case identifiers, or identifiable stories. The final city list, eligibility, translations, and any scoring require researcher review.

questions.label: After receiving the study information and an opportunity to ask questions, do you freely agree to this interview?
Which study city is this interview about?
Which age category does the participant choose to provide? Confirm the study categories before use.
Which city service would you like to discuss?
How easy or difficult was your most recent attempt to use that service?
Which barriers affected that attempt? Select any that apply.
What one change would make access easier?
